synopsis: Daisy’s new life is already a world apart from the last. Once cast out for a “worthless” job and left to die alone, she’s now the cherished daughter of a viscount—with a rare skill, a loving family, and a future that’s finally hers to shape. Sure, she’s been saddled with the “undesirable” job of Alchemist again, but things couldn’t be more different this time. With her Appraisal ability, the blessing of the spirits, and brand-new alchemy tools at her side, Daisy is ready to turn her second chance into something truly magical. Before long, she’s brewing potions for kingdoms, gathering rare materials with ease, and still finding time to bake fresh bread. This time, the overpowered alchemist is going to make sure her future shines bright! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Mimi's Tales of Terror
titleNative: ミミの怪談
synonyms: Las historias de fantasmas de Mimi
synopsis: University student Mimi and her boyfriend Naoto encounter one chilling mystery after another. There’s the enigmatic neighbor woman dressed in black from head to toe—but if she’s so odd, why does it seems like there are many others like her? Then, whose eyes track Mimi’s movements from the cemetery next door? And why does a bizarre red circle drawn on a basement wall change with each passing day? Nine scary stories that really happened, drawn from the famed collection of urban legends Shin Mimibukuro (New Earmuffs), and adapted into manga by horror genius Junji Ito! synopsis: In the urban civilization floating in space, "Cocoon", lived four students of the United Nations University: Arata, Tara, Caesar, and Louis. These four were a new breed of human, who had undergone the process of neoteny and adapted to the space age. The entirety of human relationships are decided by contracts, and while some humans get to live for hundreds of years, others are not quite so lucky. One day, these four meet a girl with green hair in the red light district, and thus our story begins.
